name: codex-image-plugin
description: A Codex plugin for generating and editing images through any OpenAI-compatible image API.

interface.shortDescription: Generate and edit images with any compatible image API
interface.longDescription: Pass an image API URL, key, and model to generate or edit images. List image-capable models exposed by the endpoint before choosing a model.
defaultPrompt: Use this image API URL and key to list available image models.
Generate an image with this image API URL, key, and model.
Edit this reference image through the supplied image API.
